verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Always near the brokenhearted
Always with me through the pain
When my fears are overwhelming
Jesus, You save me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
In my sorrow, I find comfort
In my weakness, I find strength
Every time I reach out for You
Jesus, You save me

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You are my refuge, You are my shelter
You are my hiding place forever
I will run to You, I will rest secure
In the presence of my Savior

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
You are with me every moment
You surround me day and night
Always constant, always faithful
Jesus, You save me

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I will trust, I will trust in Your promise
I am loved, I am loved, You are with me now
I will rise, I will rise in Your faithful hand
Jesus, You save me
